title: KMD Fast Travel
description: Simulates Kingdom Come deliverance fast travel in minecraft. By simulating fast travel with events.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b8f9a7fbe370cb819376912b4620177f927d35a.png)

# About
KMD tries to simulate the fast travel risk/reward and atmosphere of Kingdom Come: Deliverance inside Minecraft.

This mod is still in its early stages, with more content planned to be added over time.

# ✨ Features

- Full custom Events.
- Ability to fast travel between discovered travel posts.
- Simulated travel instead of instant teleporting.
- Random events that can interrupt fast travel.
- Hostile and passive encounters on land and at sea.
- Multiple travel post wood variants.
- Shared travel posts that can be visible to everyone.
- Renameable travel posts.
- Dyeable travel post sign text.
- Banner-based map pins.

# ⚠️ How To Use

KMD is designed as a standalone mod for stylized builds, medieval worlds, fantasy servers, and adventure-focused gameplay.

Place down a travel post and right-click it to discover/bind it. Place a second travel post, discover it, and you can fast travel between the two.

Shared travel posts are a special version of the travel post that can be visible to everyone without each player needing to discover it first.

# Encounters %
-By default all encounters are based on time of day (Night time travel higher chance for encounter)

-Distance (More distance higher chance for encounters)

-Armor level (Lowers both encounter chance but also increases chance to avoid or sneak away from encounters)

-Food Level (More hungry , more encounter chance)

All of the above can be configured via the ingame commands or the config

# Commands

All commands require permission level 2 or higher.

- `/kmdtravel events [true|false]` — Shows or toggles travel events.
- `/kmdtravel eventwait [5-600]` — Shows or changes passive-event wait time in seconds.
- `/kmdtravel basechance <0-1>` — Sets the base chance for any travel event.
- `/kmdtravel nightmultiplier <0-10>` — Sets the event chance multiplier at night.
- `/kmdtravel armor perpoint <0-0.1>` — Sets event chance reduction per armor/toughness point.
- `/kmdtravel armor maxreduction <0-0.95>` — Sets the max armor protection cap.
- `/kmdtravel hunger low <0-1>` — Sets added event chance when hunger is very low.
- `/kmdtravel hunger medium <0-1>` — Sets added event chance when hunger is medium.
- `/kmdtravel distancechance <0-1>` — Sets added event chance per 1000 blocks.
- `/kmdtravel maxchance <0-1>` — Sets the final maximum event chance cap.
- `/kmdtravel sharedpostcrafting [true|false]` — Shows or toggles shared travel post crafting.
- `/kmdtravel finishencounter @p` — Force ends an encounter a player is having.

# Misc

![Dye and Rename Shared Crafting post](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5b89047acba95dcd93acf3b5f0ed0bc8daa1d8d.png)

![renameTravelPost](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49f41e0212f5520e4db29a050420c13cceadf942.png)

- Shift right-click a travel post to rename it.
- Right-click a travel post with dye to change the sign text color.
- Right-click a travel post with a banner to change the map pin color/design.
- Passive events use a wait timer before travel continues.
- Hostile events require you to survive/clear the danger before travel continues.
